table_title: List the 16 volcanoes designated by the International Association of Volcanology and Chemistry of the Earth's Interior (IAVCEI) as 'Decade Volcanoes' under the UN International Decade for Natural Disaster Reduction (1990s), per Wikipedia's 'Decade Volcanoes' master article. For each, give the sovereign-state continent (continent of the sovereign country in which the volcano is located, with transcontinental-state edge case handled by listed volcano region's continent — Avachinsky-Koryaksky in Kamchatka Russia is Asia, Teide in Canary Islands Spain is Europe, Mauna Loa in Hawaii USA is North America), country, highest summit elevation in meters, and last known eruption start year (where the master article's 'Last known eruption' column shows a date-with-day-precision or year-with-status, extract the integer start year; for paired-volcano entries like Avachinsky-Koryaksky, use the higher elevation and later of the paired last-known-eruption-start years).
db_analog: SELECT volcano_name, sovereign_state_continent, country, highest_elevation_meters, last_known_eruption_start_year FROM volcanoes WHERE volcano_name IN (SELECT volcano_name FROM iavcei_decade_volcanoes) ORDER BY sovereign_state_continent ASC, volcano_name ASC
temporal_note: Wikipedia 'Decade Volcanoes' master article, accessed 2026-05-17. Universe is the closed canonical 16-entry list of volcanoes designated by IAVCEI under the UN International Decade for Natural Disaster Reduction (1990s), selected for (a) history of large destructive eruptions and (b) proximity to populated areas. The list has been stable since the original designations in 1991. source_count = 1 registered (master article supplies universe membership + Country/Highest Elevation/Last Known Eruption Start Year cell values via its consolidated table); 16 per-volcano Wikipedia articles consulted as validation cross-checks during curation but per the artifact contract do NOT count toward source_count and are NOT registered in source_urls — they live in curation.json::source_coverage_notes::validation_cross_checks as provenance prose. temporal_sensitivity = low because the IAVCEI Decade Volcanoes universe is a closed historical designation; member elevations are stable on benchmark timescales; only the Last Known Eruption Start Year cell is moderately mutable (Sakurajima 2025, Taal 2026, Etna 2013-present ongoing, Nyiragongo 2021-present ongoing, Mauna Loa 2022 most recent confirmed). The 16 entries: Africa 1 (Nyiragongo), Asia 5 (Avachinsky-Koryaksky, Merapi, Sakurajima, Taal, Unzen), Europe 4 (Mount Etna, Mount Vesuvius, Santorini, Teide), North America 4 (Mauna Loa, Mount Rainier, Santa María, Volcán de Colima), Oceania 1 (Ulawun), South America 1 (Galeras). Per-row cells: Volcano name verbatim from master article's row label (Avachinsky-Koryaksky as single entry per IAVCEI canonical labeling; Santa María as single entry with Santiaguito dome complex noted in normalization_decisions); Sovereign-State Continent per the locked normalization rule (continent of sovereign country for overseas-island cases; listed volcano region's continent for transcontinental sovereign states); Country from master article's Country column; Highest Elevation Meters integer (for Avachinsky-Koryaksky paired entry, use Koryaksky's 3456m — the higher of 2741/3456); Last Known Eruption Start Year integer (for date-with-day-precision values like Sakurajima '16 November 2025' → 2025; for year-with-status values like Etna '2013–present' → 2013; for paired-volcano entries like Avachinsky-Koryaksky '2008/2009' → 2009 the later year).
_extraction_notes: Geographic instance — closed canonical 16-entry IAVCEI Decade Volcanoes universe with per-continent geographic distribution shape (NOT top-N-per-continent hierarchical decomposition; per-continent row counts are determined by IAVCEI selection, not by curator-selected top-N). Single PK Volcano (volcano names are unique within the Decade Volcanoes list). Brings `geographic` from gap 3 (2 of 5 staged) to **gap 2 (3 of 5 staged)**. Geography family extends from 13 to 14 instances; Geography/Volcanology is a NEW subdomain (Geography family is already heavy at 13 instances but the gap-2 category chip + NEW fine-class + NEW subdomain combo justifies staging). NEW `physical-features/volcanoes` fine-class extending physical-features bucket from 7 to 8 instances (joining rivers×2 + mountains + deserts + islands + oceanic-trenches + lakes). Source plan: 1 registered source (master Decade Volcanoes Wikipedia article — universe + value role for all 5 cells) + 16 validation sources (per-volcano Wikipedia articles) documented in curation.json::source_coverage_notes::validation_cross_checks as provenance prose (not registered URLs per artifact-contract canonical vocab). Mirror precedent for source_count = 1 with validation-prose-only per-entity articles: `periodic_table_groups_first_three_elements_by_atomic_number` (source_count = 2 with 18 per-group validation cross-checks in prose). claim_type = source_defined (universe is the closed IAVCEI list maintained since 1991; Wikipedia 'Decade Volcanoes' article enumerates the 16 entries with stable membership; no curator judgment for universe membership). Cycle arc: 2 rounds of pre-staging design review (cycle-1 + cycle-2) terminating in 'Approve for Cycle-0 Staging With 2 Required Staging Edits' (cycle-2 audit). Both staging edits applied at cycle-0: (1) column renamed from 'Most Recent Known Eruption Year' to 'Last Known Eruption Start Year' per audit cycle-2 staging-edit #1 (since the master shows 'YEAR-present' for ongoing eruptions, the integer extraction is the start year of the listed ongoing eruption, not literally the most recent eruption year); (2) Sovereign-State Continent normalization rule tightened with the transcontinental edge-case wording per audit cycle-2 staging-edit #2 ('Use the sovereign-state political continent for overseas island cases; for transcontinental sovereign states, use the listed volcano region's continent' — makes Avachinsky-Koryaksky = Asia defensible since Kamchatka is Asian Russia). 5-cell schema (Volcano composite PK 1 / Sovereign-State Continent / Country / Highest Elevation Meters / Last Known Eruption Start Year) at 16 rows = 80 source-grounded cell values. Sort: Sovereign-State Continent ASC alphabetic (primary) → Volcano ASC alphabetic (secondary within continent). Confidence gradient: very-LLM-knowable cells include Vesuvius/Italy (79 AD Pompeii), Mauna Loa/Hawaii (active shield volcano), Etna/Italy (frequent eruptions), Sakurajima/Japan, Mount Rainier/Washington; mid-difficulty cells include continent assignments for Teide (Canary Islands → Europe per Spanish sovereignty), Mauna Loa (Hawaii → North America per US sovereignty), Avachinsky-Koryaksky (Kamchatka → Asia per transcontinental-state edge-case rule); harder calibration cells include Galeras/Colombia (1993 eruption killed volcanologists), Ulawun/Papua New Guinea (lesser-known PNG volcano), Nyiragongo/DRC vs Nyamuragira (Nyamuragira is NOT a Decade Volcano though nearby), Santa María/Santiaguito naming (Decade Volcano is Santa María; Santiaguito is the post-1902 lava dome complex). Geographic category-fit: per the geographic category contract, each row is a per-region listing emphasizing geographic distribution. The Decade Volcanoes per-continent distribution is uneven (Asia 5 / Europe 4 / N. America 4 / Africa 1 / Oceania 1 / S. America 1) reflecting the historical concentration of populated-area volcanic risk at the time of the IAVCEI 1991 designations; this uneven shape distinguishes the instance from hierarchical_decomposition (which would require top-N-per-parent uniformity).
